brief: Demo example 8. The rug-pull meme, literally carpets: the box made to miss its deadline. A plain token with nothing inside, the one raise (4.206980085 ETH) in 30 days, the creator's fees held during the curve and put into the refund range when it fails.
shows: a plain token: just the token, no NFTs and no vault
a box that fails its deadline: every token sells back from the refund range
creator fees held until graduation, into the refund range on failure
differences: Founder question: let it fail for real on Sepolia (30 days) or show the failure only in the Demo.

spec.description: Demo: the rug-pull meme, literally carpets. This box is made to miss its deadline, so every RUGS sells back from the refund range.
